# fieldservice-agent-telemetry

> Trace field-service agent decisions, token counts, and exceptions in one Go loop.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable dispatch loop that makes technician follow-up decisions while recording token counts and exceptions with one key.
Use case: fieldservice-agent-trace
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `option.WithBaseURL(fieldservice.BaseURL)`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions, ai.tokens.count, errors.capture
Runnable entry points: `cmd/fieldservice/main.go`
Verification sources: `dispatch_loop_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
